answer.text: Market fluctuations cause the actual asset allocation to drift away from the desired allocation

explanation.text: The Logic: Rebalancing is needed when market fluctuations cause the actual asset allocation to drift away from the desired allocation set in the IPS. The Trap: Calendar dates, dividend declarations, and regulatory filings do not by themselves drive the need to rebalance. Note: The trigger described in the source is drift from the desired allocation; any specific percentage band would need to be set as an IPS-level rule.
